name: Swords as a Shield
body:
You are adept at using your swords as a shield during combat.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (any sword), Two-Weapon Fighting

Benefit: When wielding a sword in each hand you gain a +2 shield bonus to AC, as you employ the swords to defend yourself. Your combat abilities are unaffected.
